translated: Right? It would be great if that switch could just stay on all the time.
My off-switch is just too strong.
[CORNER: Listener Mail] Okay, next we have a message from Radio name: Mutsuki.
This person also said, "Rina Honnizumi and Minori Suzuki, kon-more, kon-niigo!"
"I was grinding a ProSeka event the other day, and I had Sekaraji playing while I was doing my runs."
"The cast's talk was so funny and soothing that the time just flew by. Do you two have anything that helps you get work done?"
Right? I mean, if they're doing runs, that means they're playing the game...
So they're listening to us talk while playing a rhythm game.
That's like Prince Shotoku levels of multitasking.
They must have the songs memorized by now.
If they've played enough to know the notes and charts by heart, I'm so grateful.
Something that helps us get things done...
I wonder what it would be.
